answer: Each identity binds one chip-timed marathon from the Shale Series: 42.195 km on a tundra course, timed at 8 splits on one timing thread, plus 25 POA locked 90 days. Bonds climb by cluster rank: the nth finish from one wallet locks 25n POA, so 100 fakes lock 126,250 POA and need 100 runners for 4,219.5 km in 500 race hours, against 25 POA for one honest run. A finish stays valid 24 months; after expiry the identity has 90 days to log a new 10 km race, or it loses half the bond and payouts for 3 epochs. Bib mules fail photo checks at each split; wheelchair racers use a 10 km course.
